content:
emma_support: Heads-up — Customer Acme sent an escalation: invoice for 2026-11-03 shows ~2x token usage for a 30m window. They say their client got timeouts and retried. Ticket: https://redwood.support/t/ACME-872. Can billing/infra triage?

oliver_customer: Got the customer's repro steps from their app team: 1) mobile call times out after 10s, 2) SDK retries without idempotency key on chunked upload, 3) server processes both, client sees success once. They attached client logs and request_ids.

sam_billing: Looking at ledger for Acme, I see duplicate metering events for same user/session around 2026-11-03T14:02Z. Two distinct meter entries with same prompt hash and different request_id headers: rq_9a1f and rq_9a1f-retry. Billing shows token counts doubled for those entries.

jordan_infra: We had an edge-proxy redeploy 2067002400 -> v2.3.4 that included a change to header normalization. There's a known edgecase where certain streaming chunk requests lost custom headers (incl. Idempotency-Key) when being re-dispatched after a 504. Could be this.

maria_devx: Repro note: mobile SDK v1.8.2 sends idempotency header only on first POST but not on resumed chunk requests. Combined with proxy header strip, server never saw idempotency header on replay. Repro steps we used:

```bash
# simulate client timeout then retry without idempotency header
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hi","idempotency_key":"abc-123"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --max-time 4 || true
# immediate retry simulating SDK resume (header dropped)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jordan_infra: Confirmed in edge logs: replayed request arrived with X-Forwarded-For and no Idempotency-Key. Edge produced a new internal request_id. Server treated as new invocation and charged tokens.

sam_billing: Can we get the list of affected request_ids so we can compute duplicate token amount? I can draft a credit plan once we have the dedupe set.

emma_support: Customer provided a small sample of request ids in ticket: [rq_9a1f, rq_9a1f-retry, rq_b4c2, rq_b4c2-retry, rq_ef01]. Full export attached to ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy: edge-proxy v2.3.5 -> rolling 2067003600 — patch: preserve custom headers on retry-path.

jordan_infra: Hotfix rolling now. Also proposing a server-side soft-dedupe: if same user, same model, same prompt hash and token_count within 5% arrives within 120s, mark as potential-duplicate and emit meter with "dup_probe" tag instead of full charge. Allows us to identify and backfill safely. Thoughts?

maria_devx: +1. Also pushing a small SDK patch to ensure idempotency header persisted across resume/retry paths in v1.8.3. I'll open PR and ping mobile folks.

sam_billing: Once we have the list, I will: 1) compute tokens for dup events, 2) issue invoice credit memos for duplicate token amounts, 3) record reason code "edge-retry-header-strip". We'll notify finance.

omitted_customer: (via pasted quote) "We only retried once — we see double charges for the same prompt. We need credits and what changed on your side?"

emma_support: Reply planned: apologize, explain transient proxy bug + SDK interaction, commit to credits for confirmed duplicates and timeline for fix + SDK release. Will ask CS to offer interim credit.

jordan_infra: Postmortem action items: - telemetry: log original client idempotency key (if present) into request trace; - metrics: count of replays that lack idempotency header; - rate-limit replays per-session to avoid fanout.

maria_devx: I'll open the SDK PR and update the mobile changelog. Tagging @mobile-team to prioritize.

sam_billing: Filing refund plan: estimate affected tokens ~48k for Acme; propose 100% credit for duplicates. Waiting on final confirmation after list.

emma_support: Customer notified about investigation. CS to send interim message offering temporary credit.

oliver_customer: Customer accepted interim credit offer, wants final confirmation before EOD Friday.

sam_billing: Will prioritize ledger export and draft credit memo by EOD.

jordan_infra: Hotfix finished and verified in staging. Rolling to prod now. Will follow up with post-deploy validation script to scan for replays missing idempotency headers in last 24h.

maria_devx: SDK PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/mobile-sdk/pull/452 — includes idempotency persistence and test.

emma_support: Great work team. Please ensure billing adjustments are logged in ticket and customer receives a summary. :thumbsup:
